summary.name: Comic Book Art, in the Drawing and Illustration category. The source explicitly names this visual direction, so its provenance is explicit.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: panel layouts, bold contours, exaggerated poses, speed lines and purposeful sound-effect lettering. Use one coherent drawing and printing language. Do not mix comic traditions such as manga and western SFX. Dialogue must stay accurate and readable.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: narrative panels and character action. Explicit pairings: inked data panels (style-097) and kinetic SFX or captions (style-093). Inferred from compatibility lists: cinematic manga-style openings, radial logo bursts and word smash cuts. Smash cuts suit concise copy, not dense explanatory text.
summary.limitations: Rough.js cannot supply handwriting, paper texture, authentic halftone or character poses. Skip motion references when the scene lacks separable subjects, actual punctuation or expressive lettering. The source review sampled only seconds 1 to 8 at one frame per second, so audio and continuous motion are unverified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent and should follow the subject, lighting and mood, not a default. Suggested tokens are illustrative, not approved: background #FFF2D9, foreground #1C2230, accents #C9403C, #E1B744 and #3768A1. Task-supplied exact colors override these, and assets must never be recolored. Use discrete tokens with no gradient. Foreground on background measures 14.35:1. Background text on accent_1 (4.427:1) is decorative only. Source examples varied, so they are observations, not mandatory choices.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Video uses an authored composition timeline and needs no pointer input. Motion-016 suits openings with separate subjects, speed lines and lettering. Motion-037 phrase scatter, motion-038 punctuation zoom, motion-039 radial burst and motion-040 smash cuts are optional when their assets exist. Keep burst confetti compact near the icon. Avoid glitch or spring effects unless requested. Allow reading holds. Reduced motion shows the completed frame.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style, and no audio layer is mandatory. Suggested options are restrained instrumental pacing, short impact accents, page or ink sounds, or silence. Narration or vocals are useful only if they aid comprehension. Keep gallery demos silent. Claim no beat synchronization unless actual audio has been inspected.
summary.assetRequirements: The supplied asset inventory is unspecified. Needed assets are separable layers for panels, characters, speed lines and lettering, with alpha and consistent dimensions. Exact approved dialogue, local fonts loaded before rendering, and glyph or mark geometry for punctuation motions are also needed. Do not invent copy or brand marks.
summary.combinations: Use this style alone for narrative panels and character action. Hybrid option style-097 places inked data charts in panels, using palette tokens and matching contour weight. Hybrid option style-093 provides hand-lettered SFX and captions. Avoid glossy gradients, distorted scales, speed lines on static values and mixed SFX conventions.
summary.productionApproach: SVG is the primary style renderer. PixiJS for sprite sets and Rough.js for sketch contours are optional, and Rough.js is used only where sketch marks are authorized. GSAP is the paused seekable timeline owner, and Motion is optional. HyperFrames is the default assembly and export pipeline. Remotion is a fallback that requires a recorded reason. Seed randomness, validate colors with chroma-js, and verify direct, forward and backward seeks in decoded frames.
